title: Equal-budget no-model smoke for the polynomial finite-sum vertical

budget.dollarCostsOmittedBecause: no real prices or fees; this smoke invents none

outOfScope: public Capability/Procedure promotion of the pack

arms.description: Existing SymPy summation baseline only. No Math Anchor method pack, no obligation checker, no A1 telescoping combination.
arms.gosperSumNote: gosper_sum is the untrusted B1/B2 constructor, not this baseline. B0 asks SymPy for the definite-sum value.

arms.description: A1 polynomial finite-sum runner: Gosper/summation construction, independent identity check, hand-provided telescoping. No extracted method pack. compare_baseline is false so B0 is not embedded.
Frozen A2 pack apply path on the A1 backend. compare_baseline is false.
Held-out cubes without the pack, only if B2 shows a reuse signal. Same execution as B1 on that task (equal-budget drop-library).

tasks.notes: A1 example / A2 extraction source. B2 on this task is a replay, not held-out reuse.

tasks.successMeans: exact rational 44100; different degree, bounds, and value from T1
tasks.notes: Not a rename of T1. T1 G and 385 must not be inputs.

tasks.successMeans: never counted as solved; B1/B2 fail-closed unsupported, not a false proposition

B0.notes: SymPy summation may return the harmonic number 11/6. That is not Math Anchor solving a polynomial finite-sum and is not counted as the negative being solved.

B2-minus.notes: B2-minus is not scheduled on this task.

latency.note: In-process wall time on this machine. First trial of a cell is labeled cold, second hot. Not a statistical benchmark. Not a dollar cost.

scoring.success: In-domain: ok with the pre-registered exact rational. Negative: never solved; B1/B2 fail-closed and not proposition-false; B0 recorded honestly.
scoring.wrongAcceptance: ok with a value other than the pre-registered exact, or B1/B2 ok on 1/k
scoring.applicabilityMisjudgment: B1/B2 reject T1 or cubes, or accept 1/k, or treat 1/k as a falsified proposition
scoring.callAloneIsNotAdoption: must stay true on B2 apply
scoring.lifecycleEvidenceHonesty: cross-task-use-evidence only on held-out cubes B2; T1 replay stays verified-in-declared-scope; neither is semantic adoption

decisionRule.promote: Forbidden in this smoke. A few integration cells are not a promotion case.
decisionRule.targeted_fix: Wrong in-domain value, negative counted as solved, coversOriginalTaskClaim true, or formal_kernel_checked true.
decisionRule.evidence_insufficient: Default when the harness is honest and in-domain cells match. Smoke is not an overall benefit percentage. Correct-but-slower vs B0 is not a promotion case.
